text: A sandbox run's summary names every test that didn't pass, first (#408). A passing run counts its passed and skipped tests by phase instead of naming them, and a run that didn't pass names at most 100 of them after the rest. A plan's pull request quotes at most 6,000 bytes of the build's summary, as it does its review. Since #404 the summary had named every test a run reached: 689,793 characters for #399's passing build of internal/verify. GitHub refused that pull request's body, over its 65,536-character limit, with HTTP 422; the factory tried again on every poll, and the agent's test tool returned the whole summary on every run. Result.TestResults still keeps every record, and failure and unfinished identities stay whole in the summary.
